name: Four Seasons Resort Los Cabos at Costa Palmas
positioning: Beachfront resort on the East Cape of Los Cabos with a swimmable beach, a marina and a golf club, 45 minutes from the airport
best_for: Travelers who want a beach resort on the East Cape, away from the Corridor crowds
Families, with a complimentary Kids For All Seasons program
Golfers, with an 18-hole Robert Trent Jones II course

facts.text: The resort has 141 rooms in total.
The resort sits on a 2 mile (3.2-kilometre) stretch of beach on the Baja Peninsula's undiscovered East Cape.
The resort has seven swimming pools.
Oasis Spa has 10 stand-alone treatment rooms.
The resort has an 18-hole Costa Palmas Golf Club designed by Robert Trent Jones II.
The resort offers 13 options for dining and drinks.
The Fitness Centre is open 24 hours every day.
The resort has an exclusive Costa Palmas marina.

highlights.text: Estiatorio Milos offers local and Mediterranean seafood at an elegant beachside restaurant.
Zest has a single table for up to 12 guests.
Oasis Spa wet areas are available for complimentary use seven days per week, with or without a spa appointment.
The Kids For All Seasons program is complimentary.
The Adventure Concierge arranges guided ATV tours through the desert foothills of the Sierra de la Laguna Mountains.
Oasis Spa was named among the 100 Best Spas in the World by Vogue for two consecutive years.

considerations.text: The resort is 45 minutes by car from Los Cabos International Airport.
Private cabanas at the adults-only pool are provided on a first come, first served basis.
WhataHotel notes the resort is located outside the central Cabo San Lucas area.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
